narrative: The technology landscape is buzzing with major developments, as Elon Musk becomes the world's first trillionaire following SpaceX's highly anticipated IPO. Concurrently, significant strides are being made in AI, with Jeff Bezos's new venture aiming to build an 'artificial general engineer' and Google DeepMind accelerating local AI capabilities. These advancements are set against a backdrop of evolving tech policy debates, particularly concerning surveillance and privacy.

highlights.title: Elon Musk becomes world's first trillionaire after SpaceX IPO
highlights.whyItMatters: This marks a historic financial milestone and underscores the growing influence of space and technology ventures.

highlights.title: SpaceX's highly anticipated IPO goes public at $150 a share
highlights.whyItMatters: The public debut of SpaceX is a major event for investors and the space industry, signaling new phases of growth and investment.

highlights.title: Jeff Bezos’ AI startup Prometheus aims to build an ‘artificial general engineer’
highlights.whyItMatters: This new venture from a prominent tech leader signifies a strategic focus on advanced AI for designing physical products.

highlights.title: OpenAI introduces new Academy courses for applying AI at work and advances agentic AI
highlights.whyItMatters: These initiatives are crucial for democratizing AI skills and enhancing productivity through intelligent agents in various workflows.

highlights.title: Google DeepMind releases DiffusionGemma, a model that runs local AI 4x faster
highlights.whyItMatters: This advancement improves the speed and accessibility of AI models for local deployment, impacting various AI applications.

highlights.title: US surveillance law (Section 702) set to expire for the first time
highlights.whyItMatters: The expiration of this key surveillance law will significantly impact privacy, national security, and technology policy debates.

highlights.title: CRISPR technology selectively shreds cancer cells, including 'undruggable' cancers
highlights.whyItMatters: This scientific breakthrough offers new hope for treating difficult-to-target cancers, potentially revolutionizing oncology.

highlights.title: Cloudflare scales security insights and introduces real-time WAF rules
highlights.whyItMatters: Enhanced security capabilities provide better protection against cyber threats, crucial for maintaining online safety and infrastructure integrity.
